THE SERVICE MINUTE OF THE SRI LANKA PRINCIPALS’ SERVICE
1st Amendment

THE Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Principals’ Service published in the Gazette Extraordinary of the DemocraticSocialist Republic of Sri Lanka Number 1885/31 and dated 22.10.2014 will be hereby amended
By Order of the Public Service Commission
H. M. GAMINI SENEVIRATHNE,Secretary,Public Service Commission.27th December 2016.
SectionSubRevisionNo.Section

(a) The officers, who are in the Grade I Class 2 of the Sri Lanka Principals’ Service as atthe effective date of the Service Minute and who have fulfilled qualifications to bepromoted to Class I of the Sri Lanka Principals’ Service as at 01.07.2008 in accordancewith the prior Service Minute are absorbed to Class I of the Sri Lanka Principals’Service.
and

(b) The officers in Grade I Class 2 of the Sri Lanka Principals’ Service as at the effectivedate of this Service Minute have not fulfilled qualifications to be promoted to ClassI of the Sri Lanka Principals’ Service as at 01.07.2008 in accordance with the priorService Minute are absorbed to Class I of the Sri Lanka Principals’ Service subjectedto the conditions mentioned below
I. the seniority of these officers should be placed below the seniority of all theother officers absorbed to Class I with effect from 01.07.2008.

II. These Officers are entitled only to the salary of Class I of the Sri Lanka Principals’Service.

III. The Officers would be qualified to be promoted to the Sri Lanka EducationAdministrative/Teacher Educators’ Service under the merit/limited streams, which arefor the Principals of Class I of the Sri Lanka Principals’ Service, from the date offulfilling the other qualifications including the period of service required to bepromoted to Grade I under the Service Minute existed as at 30.06.2008.

Note : It is compulsory for the Officers to pass the Efficiency Bar Examination prescribedfor Grade I of Class 2 under the Service Minute existed as at 30.06.2008 or theSecond Efficiency Bar Examination mentioned in the new Service Minute in order toobtain other benefits except the salary.
